patterns: Kling Image 4.0 launch day owned the feed: CharaspowerAI's 'getting SCARY realistic' test series led on views (78.2K, but only 22 likes - reach without engagement), maxescu's '16 models tested, prompt below' comparison hit 17.4K / 142 bookmarks.
Cost-vs-studio framing is the engagement winner: EHuanglu's 'a 3-min 3D AI animation like this costs $350 now' hit 58.5K / 356 likes / 143 bookmarks.
'X but it's 197x' for a 4th day: techhalla's 'Karate Kid but it's 1971' 12.9K with the best like rate of the day (391 likes) - one-line title, zero tool talk.
Creator-platform news travels: Salmaaboukarr on Instagram flagging copied videos 20.9K / 113 bookmarks; minchoi's 'This is wild' AI news (miHoYo game-playing AI 17.0K, Claude Code iPhone fold 9.6K).
Outsiders: Seedance MCP / Higgsfield price war (YouArtStudio 75.3K) and 'every AI video model still struggles with opening a can' (omidaziz 24.1K) - physics-fail tests get attention.
